concepts.title: Y2K 千禧数码风
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone polished landscape game concept presentation board, about 4:3, high detail and readable Chinese text, for PCShop 湖畔四区, a Chinese city life simulation and small business management game. The supplied image is a COMPOSITION REFERENCE only, not an edit target: follow its generous main gameplay panel, smaller lower aerial overview and lower dialogue UI, but fully replace its anime style with the specific requested art style.
Shared content across all ten boards: one attractive main playable streetscape panel (about top/middle 50 percent) in elevated oblique 3D/isometric view showing a small electronics and secondhand shop with visible cutaway shelves and checkout, a neighboring neighborhood eatery, a player and several named/unnamed pedestrians walking on the lakeside commercial street; readable in-game HUD integrated at the top, e.g. 周一 10:24, ¥10,000, 精力 92/100, 背包, 日程. Make this believable as a game visualization, not just a cover painting.
Bottom left about 30 percent: actual broad bird's-eye overview of a large central lake encircled by four distinct inhabited districts, connected by winding long scenic roads through woods and hills. Bottom-left 城郊片: compact wholesale sheds on left, small commercial middle, dense modest tiny urban-village homes right. Bottom-right 社区片: medium-rise apartments and everyday shops. Upper-right 公园片: highrise park apartments and quality commercial buildings. Upper-left 花园片: elegant modern villas with private gardens and individual pools plus premium businesses. Two intersecting lake-crossing bridges visually closed, label 跨湖道路·暂未开放. Four district labels clearly placed; there are ONLY FOUR agencies, one per district, no need to label each. Geography readable and same across styles.
Bottom right about 30 percent: close-up NPC dialogue UI with a large portrait of a friendly young adult Chinese woman shopkeeper 阿芳, matching the style exactly, speech “今天想聊些什么？” and three obvious choices “聊聊近况”, “谈论别人”, “邀请出游”, plus 羁绊 30. The game's world should still have Chinese everyday community commerce and life, not turn into unrelated science fiction or a different setting.
Top header prominently shows the requested style name plus smaller “湖畔四区 · 游戏美术概念”. Bottom narrow strip includes 5 palette swatches and 3 short material/style keywords. Make all panels, characters, architecture, environment rendering, UI typography and UI materials express the same specific style, with strong visual separation between styles. Avoid watermarks, brands, huge paragraphs, illegible small text. Deliver just this ONE concept sheet, not a grid of ten.
STYLE TITLE (verbatim): Y2K 千禧数码风
STYLE/MEDIUM — highest priority: Transparent jelly acrylic, chromed silver architecture accents, electric cyan and lime green, translucent early-2000s consumer electronics, glossy bubble icons, early internet optimistic futurism. Distinct translucent jelly UI windows, chrome embossed headings, silver kiosks.
